title: Skimmer vs Pool Brain (2026): Per-Pool vs Per-Tech Pricing
description: Skimmer vs Pool Brain: $1-$2 per pool vs $50 + $65 per tech, cost for 1-10 tech routes, chemical dosing, routing, QuickBooks and trials. Checked Nov 10.
h1: Skimmer vs Pool Brain for pool service companies
body:
Skimmer and Pool Brain are two of the pool-only service apps that pool route owners compare most often, and they bill in opposite ways. Skimmer charges per serviced location (each pool address you service that month) with unlimited techs and admins. Pool Brain charges a $50/mo base plus $65/mo per active field technician, with unlimited office users and every feature included. Every number below comes from each vendor's own pages, checked on 2026-11-10 (Skimmer pricing, Pool Brain pricing, Pool Brain features). If a vendor doesn't publish something, we mark it unknown.

{{table:skimmer,pool-brain}}

Pricing models: per pool vs per tech

  • Skimmer: Getting Started is $1 per serviced location per month, starting at $49/mo (includes 49 locations), and Skimmer describes it as built for 0-49 pools. Scaling Up is $2 per serviced location, starting at $98/mo (includes 49 locations), for 50-1,000 pools. Enterprise (1,000+ pools) is custom priced. You're billed once a month per address no matter how many visits or bodies of water, and locations you don't service that month aren't billed. Annual pricing: unknown.
  • Pool Brain: one plan with all features and free setup. $50/mo covers unlimited office users, and each active field technician adds $65/mo. Pool Brain's own example: 5 techs = $375/mo. Annual pricing and contract terms: unknown.

What the same pool route costs on each

We worked these out from the list prices above (USD per month, before tax, payment processing and add-ons). The pool counts per tech are example scenarios, not industry averages. For Skimmer we show Scaling Up (the plan for 50+ pools) and, under 50 pools, Getting Started too.

RouteSkimmerPool Brain
Solo, 1 tech, 30 poolsGetting Started $49 (minimum); Scaling Up $98 (minimum)$115 ($50 + 1 tech)
Solo, 1 tech, 70 poolsScaling Up $140$115
2 techs, 150 poolsScaling Up $300$180 ($50 + 2 × $65)
5 techs, 400 poolsScaling Up $800$375 ($50 + 5 × $65)
10 techs, 800 poolsScaling Up $1,600$700 ($50 + 10 × $65)

The pattern: Skimmer costs less for small or part-time routes, because Getting Started bottoms out at $49/mo and you only pay for pools you actually serviced that month. Pool Brain costs less once each tech carries a full route. With one tech, Skimmer Scaling Up ($2/pool, $98 minimum) stays under Pool Brain's $115 up to 57 pools. With five techs, the break-even is about 187 pools (37 per tech). Above that, Pool Brain's flat per-tech price wins. If your pool count swings a lot between seasons, Skimmer's unserviced-months-not-billed rule matters. If you have a lot of techs or part-time helpers, every active tech adds $65/mo on Pool Brain. More detail: Skimmer pricing by pool count and pool service software cost for every pool app side by side.

Add-ons and what's included

  • Skimmer sells add-ons on top of the per-pool price: Service Texts at $0.029/message on Getting Started (unlimited texts are included on Scaling Up), AI Phone $99/mo, Marketing Suite $150/mo and Bookkeeping from $198/mo. Its pricing page also lists CRM Integrations ($49/mo) and Google Calendar ($25/mo) on Getting Started and Scaling Up.
  • Pool Brain says all features are included with free setup and no hidden costs. Its pricing page lists no add-ons. Texting costs: unknown.

Chemical readings, dosing and LSI

Skimmer's Scaling Up plan includes an LSI and dosing calculator powered by Orenda and a LaMotte integration. Skimmer's homepage also says it tracks chemicals and installed items so they get billed. Pool Brain auto-calculates a dosage in the app when the tech enters readings, and tracks chemical use and cost by customer, job, property, body of water, technician and company. It also has custom alerts for chemicals, flow, leaks, time and cost. Pool Brain doesn't mention LSI on its features page (unknown). Skimmer's Getting Started plan doesn't list the dosing calculator. See best pool service software for chemical features across more apps.

Routing and scheduling

Skimmer includes Route Builder on every plan. Route Optimization, the Schedule and recurring work orders come with Scaling Up. Skimmer's homepage says techs can adjust stops, optimize routes and work offline in the mobile app. Pool Brain has one-click route optimization, drag-and-drop scheduling, one-time moves, an Unscheduled section for jobs and stops that need attention, multi-day views and map filters, plus automatic filter-clean and salt-cell-clean jobs on a schedule you choose. Pool Brain says its app works with no cell signal and syncs later. For route-focused options, see best pool route software and pool service scheduling software.

Billing, payments and QuickBooks

  • Skimmer: invoices generate from completed work and can be sent in bulk. Online payments, credit card surcharging and a customer portal are on Getting Started. It syncs to QuickBooks Online (Skimmer's homepage says in real time). Online payments are subject to processing fees through the payment processor and Skimmer, but the rate isn't published (unknown).
  • Pool Brain: automatic monthly billing (per visit or flat rate, in advance or in arrears), automatic card or ACH charges with a daily retry if a card declines, and 2-way QuickBooks Online sync (billing also works without QuickBooks). Card fees: unknown.

Team tools

Pool Brain lists technician pay calculations, technician scorecards, guided workflows that techs can't skip, a route profit report and proof-of-service emails. Skimmer lists service reports and emails on every plan, productivity reporting and required checklist items on Scaling Up, and live phone support on Scaling Up. Skimmer limits photos to 5 per visit on Getting Started and 20 on Scaling Up. Pool Brain's photo limits: unknown.

Trials and guarantees

Skimmer is running a promotion with the first month of Scaling Up free (up to 49 locations, new customers, through its promo link) and has a 30-day refund guarantee. Pool Brain offers a free trial, but its pricing page doesn't say how long (unknown).

Pool Brain also publishes its own Skimmer vs Pool Brain feature report. A vendor wrote it, so read it as marketing and check any feature you depend on in a demo.

Which should you pick?

  • Solo or part-time route under 50 pools: Skimmer Getting Started, at $49/mo minimum, is the lowest published price of the two. {{aff:skimmer|See Skimmer plans}}
  • Seasonal pool counts: Skimmer, because unserviced locations aren't billed that month.
  • Several techs with full routes: Pool Brain, because at $65/mo per tech it costs less than $2/pool once each tech carries more than roughly 35-57 pools (see the table). {{aff:poolbrain|See Pool Brain pricing}}
  • Training new techs and tracking chemical cost by tech or pool: Pool Brain's guided workflows and chemical cost tracking are on its single plan.
  • LSI calculations and LaMotte test kits: Skimmer Scaling Up.

faq: Is Pool Brain cheaper than Skimmer?

It depends on pools per tech. Skimmer Scaling Up is $2 per serviced location ($98/mo minimum) and Pool Brain is $50/mo plus $65/mo per active field tech. For 1 tech with 70 pools, Skimmer is $140/mo and Pool Brain $115/mo. For 1 tech with 30 pools, Skimmer Getting Started is $49/mo and Pool Brain $115/mo. Prices checked 2026-11-10.
No. Skimmer includes unlimited technicians and admins and bills $1 (Getting Started) or $2 (Scaling Up) per serviced location per month. Locations you don't service in a month aren't billed.
How much does Pool Brain cost per month?

$50/mo base, which covers unlimited office users, plus $65/mo per active field technician. One tech works out to $115/mo and five techs to $375/mo (Pool Brain's own example). All features and setup are included.
Do Skimmer and Pool Brain sync with QuickBooks?
Yes. Both list QuickBooks Online sync. Pool Brain describes it as 2-way and says billing also works without QuickBooks.
Which has chemical dosing, Skimmer or Pool Brain?

Both. Skimmer's Scaling Up plan includes an LSI and dosing calculator powered by Orenda plus a LaMotte integration. Pool Brain auto-calculates dosing from tech readings on its single plan and tracks chemical cost by customer, body of water and tech.
Do Skimmer and Pool Brain have free trials?
Skimmer currently offers the first month of Scaling Up free (promotion, new customers) and a 30-day refund guarantee. Pool Brain offers a free trial, but its length isn't published.
